# G.711 A-law decode golden: code (8-bit, as transmitted on the wire) -> 16-bit linear PCM
# Source: ITU-T G.191 STL g711.c alaw_expand() (output 16-bit left-justified = 13-bit value x8,
# midpoint of the decision interval). Cross-checked identical for all 256 codes against
# Sun Microsystems g711.c, FFmpeg pcm_alaw, SoX and CPython audioop.
